def chain_follows_chain(chain):
    tokens = list(chain)
    tokens.sort()
    for i in range(len(tokens) - 1):
        if tokens[i] == 'a' and tokens[i+1] == 'b':
            tokens.pop(i)
            tokens.pop(i)
            tokens.insert(i+1, 'c')
            tokens.sort()
            break
    return ','.join(tokens)
